description: Dual-Entry JSON drawer of Apple CLI build, test, simulator, and Swift 6 concurrency cases. Filtered by route (swiftpm/xcode/mixed) with a Top-3 disclosure cap.

active_cases.title: SwiftPM Package-Only Hard Scope Gate & Custom Target Path Verification
active_cases.symptom: Escalating package-only diffs to xcodebuild rebuilds full app schemes and masks package-level manifest or platform floor errors.
active_cases.fix_rule: Stay strictly on swift build/test (--package-path) when all non-neutral paths are inside SwiftPM package roots; inspect Package.swift custom target paths first.

active_cases.title: Xcode 27 Generic Destination Build Without Signing Coupling
active_cases.symptom: Coupling build-only verification to a named simulator or developer signing identity fails on clean environments or headless runners.
active_cases.fix_rule: Use a generic simulator destination with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO for compile checks; select an explicit simulator UDID only when running tests or launching an app.

active_cases.title: Simulator Lifecycle Isolation & Structured xcresult Summary Inspection
active_cases.symptom: Booting unverified simulator names or dumping raw xcodebuild test transcripts pollutes host devices and overflows agent context.
active_cases.fix_command: xcrun simctl list devices available --json && xcrun xcresulttool get test-results summary --path <Results.xcresult>
active_cases.fix_rule: Query available simulators via simctl --json, shut down only devices booted by the current task, and parse test bundles with xcresulttool summary/tests.

active_cases.title: Swift 6 Strict Concurrency & Actor Isolation Boundary Diagnosis
active_cases.symptom: Swift 6 Sendable or @MainActor isolation diagnostics across package/app seams are misattributed to tooling or bypassed by switching build runners.
active_cases.fix_rule: Preserve the first compiler concurrency diagnostic at the owning package or target boundary; fix @MainActor/@Sendable isolation contracts rather than falling back across routes.
